messages:
Elliot: Quick design check — I'm prototyping 'validation severity' states for rules. Instead of binary valid/invalid, we might surface Info/Warning/Error. Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/val-severity
Elliot: Question: should severity badges be shown inline on the rule row (compact) or only in the inspector panel (less noise)? @Sofia @Ravi @Ken
Sofia: I like inline badges but keep them subtle. Small left-edge color token + a 3-char badge (I / ! / X) could work. Hover expands to full text. Important: badges need accessible names (aria-label="Warning: ambiguous condition").
Ravi: Inline wins for discoverability. PMs typically scan rows quickly and miss inspector-only signals. But we must avoid clutter. Proposal: collapsed mode shows only color dot; expand-on-focus reveals pill with message and link to "Fix".
Ken: A11y: if we reveal details on focus, use aria-expanded on the rule row and aria-controls to point at the detail region. Also announce severity changes via aria-live="polite" when preview runs detect regressions.
Elliot: Good point. Copy suggestions: Info -> "Info: unused condition"; Warning -> "Warning: may not match intended traffic"; Error -> "Error: missing condition". Keep verbs actionable.
Sofia: For errors, show a permanent inline action: "Fix" button that opens the inspector and focuses the first invalid field. Button should be aria-describedby with the error summary.
Ravi: Visual: use three hues but keep saturation low so rows remain readable. Also offer an optional 'filter by severity' toggle in the top bar for quick triage.
Ken: Keyboard flow: Tab to a rule, press 'v' to cycle severity filter shortcuts? Might be unexpected. Better: provide a focusable filter chip list at the top (buttons) with clear aria-pressed states.
Elliot: Preview interaction: when a preview run produces warnings, highlight affected rules and show a stacked timeline in the preview panel: a small list of events like '2026-03-23 14:12: demo payload -> Warning on rule 3'. This helps debug flakiness.
Sofia: Nice. Timeline rows should be short and copy should include sample snippet and link to the matching rule. Use monospace for sample keys: `user.email`.
Ravi: Performance note: generating severity requires extra validation passes — debounce preview runs and reuse lint results when rules haven't changed. Also cancel stale validations.
Ken: Contrast check: small severity badges might fail at AA. ux-bot, can you run a contrast scan on the three proposed tones?
ux-bot: Contrast scan result: Error badge text fails AA at 12px with #B33B3B on white; recommend #A22F2F or white text on dark bg. Info and Warning pass with suggested tones.
Elliot: Action items: 1) Sofia to mock compact-dot + expand-on-focus interactions and badge copy. 2) Ravi to spec filter chip keyboard behavior and debounce strategy. 3) Ken to write aria-live/expanded/controls notes. 4) I'll add timeline prototype and wire sample payload linking. Review Friday.
Sofia: I'll also include a microcopy variant that reads shorter for narrow languages. Pushing updates to Figma now. :thumbsup:
Ravi: I'll add a short perf note for eng-runtime to reuse lint caches.
Ken: I'll draft the a11y appendix and include example screen reader announcements"
